data.one_liner: Custom switch button with attractive animation and customizable colors, icons, and text content.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fully customizable rolling switch widget with animations for Flutter applications. It allows developers to customize colors, icons, texts, and use custom widgets for both states, behaving similarly to the standard material switch widget.
use_when: You need a custom animated switch button instead of the standard material switch
You want to display custom icons, text, or widgets inside a toggle switch
avoid_when: You need a standard platform-native switch widget
You require complex form validation integrations out of the box
strengths: Highly customizable colors, icons, and text indicators
Supports drag-to-switch interactions and custom widgets
Null safe implementation with proper animation controller disposal
weaknesses: Very limited third-party ecosystem adoption as an initial release
No built-in form field wrapper documented
